statement: PCEXTRACTCENTERLINE must create a line along the central axis of a detected cylindrical segment in a point cloud, previewing the line before the segment is picked.
notes: Added from help page "PCEXTRACTCENTERLINE (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Select a cylindrical segment of a pipe point cloud and assert a line is created along its axis with endpoints at the cylinder ends.

statement: PCEXTRACTCORNER must place a point where three picked planar point cloud segments intersect, shown according to PDMODE and PDSIZE (with PDMODE 0 or 1 temporarily changed so it is visible).
notes: Added from help page "PCEXTRACTCORNER (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Pick the floor and two wall planar segments of a room scan and assert a point is placed at their common corner.

statement: PCEXTRACTEDGE must infer the intersection of two adjacent planar point cloud segments and create a line along that edge.
notes: Added from help page "PCEXTRACTEDGE (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Pick two adjacent wall planes and assert a line is created along their intersection.

statement: PCEXTRACTSECTION must generate 2D geometry from a section object intersecting a point cloud, using only points inside the section boundary of a live section, through the Extract Section Lines dialog.
notes: Added from help page "PCEXTRACTSECTION (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Create a live section through a scan, run PCEXTRACTSECTION and assert 2D linework matching the section slice is produced.

statement: -POINTCLOUDATTACH must attach an RCS or RCP point cloud file from the command prompt using a full or relative path (name only resolves to the drawing folder, ~ shows a dialog), with insertion point, scale and rotation.
notes: Added from help page "-POINTCLOUDATTACH (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Run -POINTCLOUDATTACH with an RCP file, insertion 0,0, scale 1 and rotation 0 and assert a point cloud object is created.

statement: POINTCLOUDCOLORMAP must open a dialog to define color schemes for Intensity, Elevation and Classification stylizations, with preset or custom schemes and tabs disabled when the cloud lacks that data.
notes: Added from help page "POINTCLOUDCOLORMAP (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Open the dialog for a cloud with intensity data, choose a scheme and assert intensity-stylized points use it.

statement: POINTCLOUDCROP must crop a point cloud by a rectangle, polygon or circle relative to the current view, keeping the inside or outside, with invert and undo-last options and crop boundaries stored in the cloud and transformed with it.
notes: Added from help page "POINTCLOUDCROP (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Crop a cloud to a rectangle keeping inside and assert points outside are no longer displayed; run Undo last and assert they return.

statement: POINTCLOUDCROPSTATE must save, restore, delete and list named crop states of a selected point cloud, with comma-separated names and * to delete all.
notes: Added from help page "POINTCLOUDCROPSTATE (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Save a crop state, crop further, restore the state and assert the earlier crop is shown again.

statement: -POINTCLOUDMANAGER must show, hide or list regions and scans of attached point clouds from the command line, using comma-separated name lists with wildcards.
notes: Added from help page "-POINTCLOUDMANAGER (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Run -POINTCLOUDMANAGER hiding scans "Scan*" and assert those scans are not displayed.

statement: POINTCLOUDMANAGER must show a palette listing attached point cloud projects, regions, unassigned points and scans in tree or list view, with per-row visibility toggles, name search, region highlighting, and viewing from a scan's camera position on double-click.
notes: Added from help page "POINTCLOUDMANAGER (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Open the palette for a project with two regions, toggle one off and assert its points are hidden.

statement: POINTCLOUDMANAGERCLOSE must close the Point Cloud Manager palette.
notes: Added from help page "POINTCLOUDMANAGERCLOSE (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Open the manager, run POINTCLOUDMANAGERCLOSE and assert it is closed.

statement: POINTCLOUDSTYLIZE must change how a point cloud is colored, offering RGB scan color, object color, normal direction, intensity, elevation and classification stylizations, with the last three depending on available data.
notes: Added from help page "POINTCLOUDSTYLIZE (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Run POINTCLOUDSTYLIZE with Elevation and assert points are colored by Z with the Earth scheme.

statement: POINTCLOUDUNCROP must permanently remove all crops from selected point clouds, whereas the Undo last option of POINTCLOUDCROP removes crops one at a time in reverse order.
notes: Added from help page "POINTCLOUDUNCROP (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Crop a cloud twice, run POINTCLOUDUNCROP and assert all points are displayed again.

statement: Dino 8 must attach point clouds from ReCap RCS scan files and RCP project files to drawings, using them as drawing guides with adjustable display and colour stylization, including ReCap-segmented planar and cylindrical data.
notes: Added from help page "About Working With Point Clouds"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Attach an RCP project file, assert the points display at the right location, then change the stylization and assert the display colours change.

statement: Dino 8 must stylize point clouds by scan colour (RGB), object colour, normal direction (fixed X/Y/Z colour scheme), and where data exists laser intensity, elevation or LAS classification.

source.ref: About Point Cloud Color Stylization and Visual Effects

notes: Added from help page "About Point Cloud Color Stylization and Visual Effects"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Stylize a cloud by elevation and assert point colours follow height; switch to a cloud lacking intensity data and assert intensity stylization is unavailable.

statement: Dino 8 must let users crop a point cloud into smaller sections to work in detail and extract 2D geometry from each cropped area with PCEXTRACTSECTION, PCEXTRACTCENTERLINE and PCEXTRACTCORNER.
notes: Added from help page "About Cropping Point Clouds"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed. Acceptance sketch: Crop a point cloud around a wall, run PCEXTRACTSECTION, and assert 2D linework from only the cropped region is generated.
